purpose: Common street obstacles; does not determine traffic light colors, all rare hazards or traversability

classes.name: pole
classes.zh: streetlight / utility / traffic signal / sign pole

annotation_rules: Class IDs are renumbered consecutively from 0 to 17; do not use them with the old 72-class weights.
Use only reviewed trunk boxes for tree trunks; do not relabel whole-tree or canopy boxes as trunks.
Pole classes retain the verified visible instance extent, including streetlight attachments; merging classes does not justify inventing occluded shafts.
Boxes from removed classes remain as ignore regions; they do not establish an absence of obstacles.
A merged class may be a negative example only when all constituent classes are confirmed absent.
Retain original videos, previous annotations and saved 72-class checkpoints; only this training round uses reduced learning targets.
